body.heading: Where in the world is Angola?
paragraphs: Angola is a country in Middle Africa, which is part of Africa.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Angola is Luanda.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Angola is Portuguese.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Angola is the Angolan kwanza.

body.heading: How big is Angola?
paragraphs: Angola covers about 1,247,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about twice the size of Central African Republic.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Kalandula Falls pours over a wide horseshoe of rock on the Lucala River — one of the biggest waterfalls in Africa, wrapped in green forest and mist.
Just south of Luanda, Kissama National Park is where elephants, giraffes and antelope roam savanna and forest near the Atlantic coast — Angola's best-known wildlife park.

body.heading: Think and talk

2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
